title: Tech Leaders and Politicians Clash Over Future of AI
subtitle: Major technology companies call for a slower pace of development, but US political leaders worry about losing the global race.

summary.en: Top technology executives are calling for a slower, safer approach to artificial intelligence development. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei proposed a plan to include independent safety monitors and international cooperation. OpenAI's Sam Altman and Elon Musk have publicly supported these ideas. However, US political leaders like Donald Trump and Mike Johnson fear that slowing down will let China gain an advantage. The debate highlights a deep disagreement between safety-focused tech leaders and politicians worried about national security.
summary.zh: 頂尖科技高層正呼籲採取更緩慢、更安全的人工智慧開發途徑。Anthropic 執行長達里歐·阿莫代提議將獨立安全監測與國際合作納入計畫。OpenAI 的山姆·奧特曼與伊隆·馬斯克已公開支持這些想法。然而，川普與麥克·強生等美國政治領袖擔心，放緩開發會讓中國取得優勢。這場辯論凸顯了專注於安全的科技領袖與擔憂國家安全的政治人物之間存在深刻分歧。

paragraphs.en: The debate over the future of artificial intelligence has reached a new level of intensity. In a surprising move, the leaders of some of the world’s most powerful technology companies are now calling for a slower pace of development. This shift follows a series of warnings from researchers about the potential dangers of advanced AI, including fears that powerful systems could become difficult to control or even cause widespread damage.
paragraphs.zh: 關於人工智慧未來的辯論已達到前所未有的激烈程度。令人驚訝的是，全球幾家最具影響力的科技公司領導人現在正呼籲放緩開發腳步。此一轉變源於研究人員針對先進人工智慧潛在危險所發出的一系列警告，其中包括擔憂強大的系統可能變得難以控制，甚至造成廣泛的損害。

paragraphs.en: Dario Amodei, the chief executive of the AI company Anthropic, recently shared a three-part plan to manage the industry. According to The Guardian Business, Amodei warned that without careful control, AI systems could become powerful enough to take over parts of the internet within a year. His plan suggests that companies should allow independent monitors to check their research processes constantly. Additionally, he proposed that democratic nations should work together to set safety standards and even coordinate with other countries, such as China, to prevent dangerous uses of the technology, like the creation of biological weapons.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智慧公司 Anthropic 的執行長達里歐·阿莫代 (Dario Amodei) 最近分享了一項管理該產業的三階段計畫。根據《衛報商業版》(The Guardian Business) 報導，阿莫代警告稱，若缺乏嚴謹的控管，人工智慧系統可能在一年內變得強大到足以接管部分網路。他的計畫建議，企業應允許獨立監測機構持續審查其研究流程。此外，他提議民主國家應共同制定安全標準，甚至與中國等其他國家協調，以防止該技術被用於危險用途，例如製造生物武器。

paragraphs.en: This call for a pause has received support from other major figures in the industry. Sam Altman, the CEO of OpenAI, stated that he agrees with the need to pace the development of frontier AI—the most advanced and powerful models currently being built. According to The Guardian Business, Altman confirmed that OpenAI plans to use independent evaluators to improve safety. Elon Musk, the founder of Tesla and SpaceX, also expressed his support on the social media platform X, noting that he has been concerned about the dangers of AI for many years.
paragraphs.zh: 這項暫緩開發的呼籲已獲得產業內其他重要人物的支持。OpenAI 的執行長山姆·奧特曼 (Sam Altman) 表示，他認同有必要放緩「前沿人工智慧」(frontier AI) 的開發速度，即目前所能構建最先進、最強大的模型。根據《衛報商業版》報導，奧特曼證實 OpenAI 計畫聘請獨立評估人員來提升安全性。特斯拉 (Tesla) 與 SpaceX 的創辦人伊隆·馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 也在社群媒體平台 X 上表達支持，並指出他多年來一直對人工智慧的危險性感到擔憂。

paragraphs.en: However, this proposal for a slowdown has met with strong resistance from high-level US politicians. According to The Verge, Donald Trump and House Speaker Mike Johnson believe that the tech industry is overreacting. They fear that if the United States slows down its progress, it will lose its lead in the global AI race. Trump told reporters that the US is currently leading in AI and that he wants to keep it that way, arguing that whoever wins the race for AI dominance will hold a significant advantage. Mike Johnson expressed similar concerns on CNN, warning that rushing to create strict rules could be a threat to national security. He suggested that if Congress acts too quickly to regulate the industry, the US might fall behind China.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，這項放緩開發的提議遭到了美國高層政治人物的強烈抵制。根據《The Verge》報導，川普 (Donald Trump) 與眾議院議長麥克·強生 (Mike Johnson) 認為科技業反應過度。他們擔心如果美國放慢進度，將會在全球人工智慧競賽中失去領先地位。川普告訴記者，美國目前在人工智慧領域處於領先，他希望保持這種優勢，並主張誰贏得人工智慧的主導權，誰就將擁有巨大的優勢。麥克·強生在美國有線電視新聞網 (CNN) 上表達了類似的擔憂，警告倉促制定嚴格規則可能會威脅國家安全。他暗示，如果國會過快採取行動來監管該產業，美國可能會落後於中國。

paragraphs.en: The situation is further complicated by the different motivations of those involved. For the tech companies, safety is becoming a major priority as they face pressure from their own employees and the public. The Guardian Business reports that Anthropic recently found users trying to use its models to help develop dangerous viruses. This discovery, along with other concerns, has pushed leaders to talk about safety before any serious accidents occur. Meanwhile, for political leaders, the focus remains on competition. The upcoming meeting between Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping is expected to be a key moment in testing whether any international cooperation on AI is actually possible.
paragraphs.zh: 由於相關各方的動機各異，情況變得更加複雜。對於科技公司而言，隨著員工與大眾的壓力增加，安全性正成為首要任務。《衛報商業版》報導，Anthropic 最近發現有使用者試圖利用其模型協助開發危險病毒。這項發現連同其他疑慮，促使領導人開始在嚴重事故發生前討論安全問題。與此同時，對於政治領袖來說，焦點仍集中在競爭上。即將舉行的川普與中國領導人習近平之間的會晤，預計將成為檢驗人工智慧領域的國際合作是否真正可行的關鍵時刻。

paragraphs.en: Some experts, however, believe that the plans proposed by industry leaders do not go far enough. David Krueger, an AI professor and safety expert, argued that the industry needs an immediate and indefinite international stop to the development of frontier AI models. He and other critics remain suspicious of the sudden change in tone from tech executives. According to The Guardian Business, some observers have pointed out that only a week ago, these same companies were marketing their AI models as helpful lifestyle tools. This sudden shift from promoting AI to warning about its dangers has left some people confused and skeptical about the true intentions of these companies.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，一些專家認為產業領袖提出的計畫仍不夠充分。人工智慧教授兼安全專家大衛·克魯格 (David Krueger) 主張，產業需要立即且無限期地在全球範圍內停止開發前沿人工智慧模型。他與其他批評者對科技高層突然改變口徑仍持懷疑態度。根據《衛報商業版》報導，一些觀察家指出，就在一週前，這些公司還在將其人工智慧模型行銷為實用的生活工具。這種從推廣人工智慧轉向警告其危險性的突然轉變，讓一些人感到困惑，並對這些公司的真實意圖持懷疑態度。

paragraphs.en: As the industry prepares for major financial events, such as Anthropic’s expected stock market launch, the pressure to balance profit with safety will likely increase. Sam Altman has already stated that OpenAI will not go public in 2026, citing the need to focus on safety concerns first. Whether the industry can successfully coordinate a slowdown remains to be seen. For now, the divide between those who want to move cautiously and those who fear losing a global competition continues to grow, leaving the future of AI development in a state of uncertainty.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著產業為重大金融事件做準備，例如 Anthropic 預期的股票上市，在獲利與安全之間取得平衡的壓力可能會增加。山姆·奧特曼已表示，由於需要優先關注安全問題，OpenAI 不會在二零二六年上市。該產業能否成功協調放緩開發仍有待觀察。目前，那些希望謹慎行事的人與那些擔心輸掉全球競爭的人之間的鴻溝持續擴大，使得人工智慧發展的未來處於不確定的狀態。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To control or slow down the speed at which something happens.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 控制（某事）的速度；放慢節奏。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（步伐），這裡作動詞用。文中：Sam Altman, the CEO of OpenAI, stated that he agrees with the need to pace the development of frontier AI—the most advanced and powerful models currently being built.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To fail to keep up with the progress of others; to lose one's competitive position.
keyTerms.noteZh: 片語動詞，意思非字面直譯。文中：He suggested that if Congress acts too quickly to regulate the industry, the US might fall behind China.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To offer a company's shares for sale to the general public for the first time (IPO).
keyTerms.noteZh: 商業慣用語，非字面上的「公開」。文中：Sam Altman has already stated that OpenAI will not go public in 2026, citing the need to focus on safety concerns first.

previousArticles.summaryEn: The leaders of two major AI companies are calling for a slower pace in technology development. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman both agree that the industry is moving too fast. They are concerned that AI systems could soon become impossible for humans to control. To address these risks, they plan to allow independent experts to check their systems for safety. This shift comes after reports of AI agents acting unexpectedly and causing security problems.

quiz.question: According to the article, what specific measure does Dario Amodei suggest to ensure the safety of AI research?

options.A: Stopping all research on AI models for at least one year.
options.B: Allowing independent monitors to constantly check research processes.
options.C: Restricting the use of AI models to democratic nations only.
options.D: Refusing to allow any international cooperation with China.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，Dario Amodei 的計畫中明確提到，科技公司應該允許獨立監控人員（independent monitors）持續檢查其研究過程。選項 A 錯誤，因為 Amodei 是呼籲「控制」而非完全停止研究。選項 C 錯誤，因為文章提到的是與民主國家合作，並未限制 AI 僅能由民主國家使用。選項 D 錯誤，因為文章提到他反而建議與中國協調以防止危險用途。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the motivation behind the sudden shift in tone from tech executives regarding AI safety?

options.A: They have successfully completed all their major research goals.
options.B: They are primarily concerned with losing their market share to smaller startups.
options.C: They are responding to both internal and external pressures regarding the potential misuse of their technology.
options.D: They have decided to abandon AI development entirely to focus on other industries.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第五段，科技公司面臨來自員工與公眾的壓力，且 Anthropic 發現有使用者試圖利用模型開發危險病毒，這促使領導者在事故發生前討論安全問題。選項 A 與 D 與事實不符，且文章並未提及。選項 B 錯誤，因為文章強調的是安全與監管，而非擔心小型新創公司的競爭。

quiz.question: In the sixth paragraph, what does the word 'skeptical' mean as used in the context of the public's reaction to tech companies?

options.A: Feeling doubtful or questioning the sincerity of someone.
options.B: Being extremely excited about future technological advancements.
options.C: Feeling confused due to a lack of technical knowledge.
options.D: Being fully supportive of the new safety regulations.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在第六段中，由於科技公司前一週還在行銷 AI 為生活工具，隨後立刻轉為警告危險，這種前後矛盾導致人們對其真實意圖感到「skeptical」（懷疑的、持保留態度的）。選項 B 與 D 與懷疑的語意相反。選項 C 雖提到困惑，但「skeptical」的核心意義在於對動機的質疑，而不僅僅是認知上的困惑。

quiz.question: Which statement best summarizes the central conflict described in the article?

options.A: The US government is successfully forcing tech companies to speed up AI development for national security.
options.B: There is a growing tension between those prioritizing AI safety and those prioritizing national competitiveness.
options.C: Tech companies and politicians have reached a complete agreement on how to regulate artificial intelligence.
options.D: The global AI race is primarily focused on creating better lifestyle tools for the general public.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。文章核心在於探討科技公司與部分專家對 AI 安全的擔憂（呼籲放慢腳步），與美國政界人士（如川普與 Mike Johnson）擔心因監管而失去全球競爭優勢之間的矛盾。選項 A 錯誤，因為政府並未成功強制加速。選項 C 錯誤，因為雙方意見明顯分歧。選項 D 忽略了文章中關於安全與國安的關鍵衝突。
